parallel.requirements: Recognized the stream-mining stack: VFDT, CVFDT, ADWIN, MOA-style ensemble evaluation, SAM-KNN, public APIs, and run.sh metric lines.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used three design subagents for tree, ADWIN, and ensemble/SAM analysis while the parent retained implementation, patch, and verification ownership.
parallel.implementation: Implemented and committed VFDT and CVFDT, then created ADWIN package files and added ADWIN runner wiring before the parent stream disconnected.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivered only vfdt.diff and cvfdt.diff as requirement patches; ADWIN work was not committed and MOA/SAM were absent from delivered patches.
parallel.verification: Ran focused local VFDT/CVFDT checks and an ADWIN experiment smoke run, then official evaluation ran and failed the VFDT numeric value tests.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: ADWIN, MOA, and SAM-KNN remained incomplete by outer-loop accounting; official solution_passed was false and the parent process ended with unknown_agent_error.

serial.requirements: Read the same requirements and worked through all five required modules and public entry points.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept all analysis, implementation, integration, verification, and final reporting in a single serial thread with no child agents.
serial.implementation: Implemented VFDT, CVFDT, ADWIN, MOA, and SAM-KNN, including stream package files and top-level runner wiring.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Produced five requirement patch artifacts and committed five implementation stages, with sam_knn.diff left untracked after the final staging workflow.
serial.verification: Ran the full integrated run.sh and printed all sixteen expected metric lines before final response; official evaluation still failed VFDT value assertions.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No requirement remained unfinished by outer-loop accounting, but the VFDT accuracy and tree-node outputs did not match official expected values.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the same five required modules and public entry points from the prompt.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had the same prompt and the same five-module stack and output-format obligations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirements difference at prompt intake; later divergence is in completion coverage, not in the stated task.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent spawned tree, ADWIN, and ensemble/SAM design helpers, then retained implementation ownership locally.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run used no child agents and carried the implementation sequence itself through all five requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used design-only delegation while the serial control kept ownership in one continuous implementation thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent received design reports for ADWIN, ensemble/SAM, and tree work and then used them as guidance rather than receiving completed code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run built the same interfaces directly in one context and later ran the integrated script with all metric names present.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel handoffs were advisory design notes; serial avoided cross-agent handoff boundaries and carried implementation context through completion.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent committed VFDT and CVFDT and began ADWIN files before the parent stream disconnected.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run implemented VFDT, CVFDT, ADWIN, MOA, and SAM-KNN and committed the last implementation stage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached all five implementation areas, while parallel stopped after two committed requirement patches and an uncommitted ADWIN attempt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The design subagent results returned to the parent, and the parent continued local work before the terminal stream failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to join; local results were committed and reported from the same execution thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel child results were available design inputs, not completed implementations requiring a missing join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The harness collected only vfdt.diff and cvfdt.diff from the parallel run.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial patch timeline showed all five requirement patch artifacts including sam_knn.diff.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered a partial final patch set; serial delivered the full patch set despite leaving the last diff untracked in the working tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel local checks reached VFDT/CVFDT and ADWIN smoke output, but official evaluation failed the VFDT accuracy and node-count values.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran the full integrated runner and printed all sixteen metrics, yet official evaluation failed the same VFDT value assertions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had broader pre-closure verification, but the official failure relation stayed the same because both missed the VFDT numeric expectations.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel process ended with return code 1 and only 40 percent requirement progress after a stream disconnect.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial process completed normally and the outer loop recorded all requirements complete.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was an agent/process failure before completing remaining modules; serial closure was normal but still evaluator-failing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official evaluations completed and both failed the same VFDT value tests, so there is no discordant official outcome. The material process difference is coverage: the parallel run used design-only subagents and ended with only VFDT/CVFDT patches after a parent stream disconnect, while the serial run completed and verified a five-module stack. That broader serial coverage did not overcome the shared VFDT numeric mismatch.
parallel_contributors: Parent process ended with unknown_agent_error after ADWIN smoke output and before committing ADWIN, MOA, or SAM-KNN.
Harness collected only two requirement patches from the parallel run.
Design subagent reports were advisory and did not constitute completed implementation artifacts.
serial_contributors: Serial run completed all five requirement areas and printed all sixteen requested metric lines.
Serial harness collected five requirement patches and the process exited normally.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts failed the official VFDT_ACCURACY expected value.
Both attempts failed the official VFDT_TREE_NODES expected value.
The shared official failure is best attributed to ordinary implementation/evaluator-target mismatch rather than a parallel coordination pattern.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process contrast explains coverage difference but not a discordant official result

candidates.reason: Rejected: the parent retained implementation ownership and actually implemented VFDT/CVFDT; the shortfall came from parent turn failure before later modules, not an ownerless plan.
Rejected: there were not multiple independently implemented child components needing an unowned integration owner; child outputs were design notes.
Rejected: final assembly was not delegated without an owner; the parent was assembling run_experiments and run.sh until its stream failed.
Rejected: the parent owned the end-to-end sequence of requirement commits and tests; the run ended early rather than lacking a pipeline owner.
Rejected: no mandatory serial preflight blocked productive work; implementation started immediately and continued while child design work ran.
Rejected: investigation and implementation overlapped, and child design reports returned while the parent was already implementing VFDT/CVFDT.
Rejected: the trace does not show available workers being assigned to auxiliary work while an indispensable implementation path was starved; the parent was the active implementer.
Rejected: three design children were not excessive breadth and the concrete terminal event was a stream disconnect, not collective fan-out consuming the finite budget.
Rejected: no child received implementation scope that it failed to checkpoint; each child produced design guidance rather than owning a deliverable.
Rejected: the design children were not asked to produce final code, and no omitted known requirement made a child result unusable.
Rejected: no separately implemented child components were expected to interoperate, so no missing cross-agent interface contract produced incompatibility.
Rejected: no known finding is shown disappearing across a handoff; returned design notes were visible to the parent.
Rejected: returned design notes were long but were not the reason a dependent action became unfinished; the parent continued local implementation until stream failure.
Rejected: there is no evidence the parent consumed a report describing superseded workspace or requirement state.
Rejected: child reports did not present incompatible contracts that remained unadjudicated at a decision point.
Rejected: the parallel parent made no whole-task completion claim or final acceptance decision; final response was empty after turn failure.
Rejected: no retry or replacement agent repeated prior work without inherited checkpoint information.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: Rejected: no child was explicitly stopped, cancelled, or interrupted before returning; the terminal failure occurred in the parent run.
Rejected: a complete all-module candidate was not available in the parallel run awaiting final promotion; ADWIN was uncommitted and MOA/SAM were unimplemented.
Rejected: no child result or implementation change was merged after the relevant integrated verification without a post-merge check.
Rejected: no delegated implementation was completed and left unjoined; children returned design notes, not code patches.
Rejected: no verifier child produced a trapped concrete finding; the children were design helpers whose results reached the parent.
Rejected: no required child failed, aborted, or was cancelled; the unrecovered failure was the parent process stream disconnect.
Rejected: the parent received design results and proceeded consistently with them at least through VFDT/CVFDT/ADWIN work, not by ignoring an available completed result.
Rejected: the parent used wait/list/followup monitoring and did not simply wait blindly until a deadline without inspecting progress.
Rejected: no concurrent agents wrote overlapping implementation files or competing component implementations.
Rejected: no two live agents edited the same source file and forced reconciliation.
Rejected: no source produced or owned by another agent was replaced or deleted by the parent or another child.
Rejected: no required executable or submitted entry point was overwritten while another agent owned or used it.
Rejected: no broad cleanup or promotion replaced another actor's final-tree work.
Rejected: although agents shared a workspace, the children made no edits and no provenance or unstable-state problem resulted.
Rejected: no generated file, cache, fixture, or temporary artifact from one concurrent actor was consumed as stable input by another.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Parent stream disconnect, stale todo state, partial patches, and missing later modules were treated as one terminal process-failure chain, not split into lifecycle/load labels.
Design handoffs were not labeled as missing joins because they were advisory reports, not delegated implementation artifacts.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no candidate met the paired retention gate for a realized parallel coordination error.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No label was retained from task difficulty, ordinary VFDT value mismatch, child count, or parent process failure alone.
